4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMap
7	
8	/-!
9	# The locally certified divisor vehicle is a Zariski sheaf on the slice (DD-2 S6a)
10	
11	The sheaf condition of the locally certified vehicle `divFamZar` for *arbitrary*
12	Zariski open covers of *arbitrary* tests in `Over (Spec k)` — the separation and
13	gluing halves, lifted from the affine basic-open S5b keystones
14	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg` / `…ZarGlue`) through the
15	affine-opens limit.  This is the `Pic0ZariskiSheaf` mirror on the Addendum-2 carrier
16	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6), in the form the DD-R lane's `divRep` restatement
17	consumes.
18	
19	## Separation
20	
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.ext_of_le_cover`: two sections of `divFamZar C π n T`
22	  agreeing on every affine open subordinate to an open cover of `T.left` agree.
23	
24	## Gluing
25	
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.LocalData`: compatible local data on an open cover —
27	  a locally certified class at every affine open subordinate to a cover member,
28	  restricting correctly within a member (`res`) and agreeing across members on shared
29	  affine opens (`glue`).
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.IsGlueValue`: the characterizing property of the value
31	  at an affine open of a section glued from compatible local data.  Values are unique
32	  (`glueValue_unique`) and exist (`exists_isGlueValue`).
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.existsUnique_glue_of_le_cover`: **the gluing half** —
34	  a family of local sections on an open cover, compatible on the affine overlaps,
35	  glues to a unique section of `divFamZar C π n T`.
36	-/
37	
38	set_option autoImplicit false
39	/- Statements mix the section rings `Γ(T.left, ·)` with the locally certified
40	divisor-functor values over them, which are stated on the product spelling
41	`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
42	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
43	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
44	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
45	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
46	
47	universe u
48	
49	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace
50	
51	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
52	
53	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
54	
55	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
56	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
57	
58	namespace divFamZar
59	
60	/-! ## Separation -/
61	
62	/-- **Separation of the locally certified vehicle** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6,
63	Addendum 2 — the `picEt.ext_of_le_cover` mirror): two sections of `divFamZar C π n T`
64	agreeing on every affine open subordinate to an open cover of `T.left` are equal — the
65	separation half of the Zariski sheaf property at an arbitrary test. -/
66	theorem ext_of_le_cover {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {ι' : Type*}
67	    (O : ι' → T.left.Opens) (hcov : ∀ p : T.left, ∃ i, p ∈ O i)
68	    {s t : divFamZar C π n T}
69	    (h : ∀ (U : T.left.affineOpens) (i : ι'), U.1 ≤ O i → s.1 U = t.1 U) : s = t := by
70	  classical
71	  refine ext fun U => ?_
72	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover U.2
73	    (fun U₀ => ∃ i, U₀ ≤ O i)
74	    (fun w _ => by
75	      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov w
76	      exact ⟨O i, hi, ⟨i, le_rfl⟩⟩)
77	  refine eq_of_basic_eq U sub hspan (fun r hr => ?_)
78	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨i, hle⟩, hrle⟩ := hsub r hr
79	  rw [s.compat ⟨_, U.2.basicOpen r⟩ U (T.left.basicOpen_le r),
80	    t.compat ⟨_, U.2.basicOpen r⟩ U (T.left.basicOpen_le r)]
81	  exact h ⟨T.left.basicOpen r, U.2.basicOpen r⟩ i (hrle.trans hle)
82	
83	/-! ## Local data on an open cover -/
84	
85	variable {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {ι : Type u} (O : ι → T.left.Opens)
86	
87	/-- **Compatible local data** on an open cover `O` of `T.left`: a locally certified
88	class at every affine open subordinate to a cover member, restricting correctly within
89	a member (`res`) and agreeing across members on shared affine opens (`glue`).  This is
90	the input of the gluing half — the vehicle-native spelling of a compatible family of
91	local sections of `divFamZar` over the cover. -/
92	structure LocalData (v : ∀ (i : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens), W.1 ≤ O i →
93	    DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n) : Prop where
94	  res : ∀ (i : ι) (W W' : T.left.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ O i) (hW' : W'.1 ≤ O i)
95	    (h : W.1 ≤ W'.1),
96	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (v i W' hW') = v i W hW
97	  glue : ∀ (i j : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens) (hi : W.1 ≤ O i) (hj : W.1 ≤ O j),
98	      v i W hi = v j W hj
99	
100	variable (v : ∀ (i : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens), W.1 ≤ O i →
101	  DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n)
102	
103	/-- The characterizing property of the glued value at `W`: on every affine sub-open of
104	`W` contained in a cover member, it restricts to the local datum there. -/
105	def IsGlueValue (W : T.left.affineOpens) (z : DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n) : Prop :=
106	  ∀ (W₀ : T.left.affineOpens) (hW₀ : W₀.1 ≤ W.1) (i : ι) (hi : W₀.1 ≤ O i),
107	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T hW₀) z = v i W₀ hi
108	
109	variable {O v}
110	
111	/-- Glued values are unique — from the Zariski separation over a basic refinement
112	subordinate to the cover. -/
113	theorem glueValue_unique (hcov : ∀ p : T.left, ∃ i, p ∈ O i)
114	    {W : T.left.affineOpens} {z z' : DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n}
115	    (hz : IsGlueValue O v W z) (hz' : IsGlueValue O v W z') : z = z' := by
116	  classical
117	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
118	    (fun U₀ => ∃ i, U₀ ≤ O i)
119	    (fun w _ => by obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov w; exact ⟨O i, hi, ⟨i, le_rfl⟩⟩)
120	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W sub hspan (fun r hr => ?_)
121	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨i, hi⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
122	  rw [hz ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T.left.basicOpen_le r) i (hle.trans hi),
123	    hz' ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T.left.basicOpen_le r) i (hle.trans hi)]
124	
125	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
126	-- The instance towers over the section rings of the basic refinement exceed the
127	-- default elaboration budget (as in `Pic0ZariskiSheaf.exists_isGlueValue`).
128	/-- **Existence of the glued value**: compatible local data on an open cover has a
129	value at every affine open of `T.left`, glued over a finite basic-open refinement
130	subordinate to the cover — the S5b gluing keystone through
131	`divFamZar.exists_glue_of_basic_compat`. -/
132	theorem exists_isGlueValue (hcov : ∀ p : T.left, ∃ i, p ∈ O i)
133	    (hv : LocalData O v) (W : T.left.affineOpens) :
134	    ∃ z, IsGlueValue O v W z := by
135	  classical
136	  -- the basic refinement subordinate to the cover
137	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
138	    (fun U₀ => ∃ i, U₀ ≤ O i)
139	    (fun w _ => by obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov w; exact ⟨O i, hi, ⟨i, le_rfl⟩⟩)
140	  have hsub' : ∀ r ∈ sub, ∃ i, T.left.basicOpen r ≤ O i := fun r hr => by
141	    obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨i, hi⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
142	    exact ⟨i, hle.trans hi⟩
143	  choose ic hic using hsub'
144	  have hbmul : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
145	      T.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T.left, W.1)))
146	        ≤ T.left.basicOpen (r : Γ(T.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
147	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
148	    exact inf_le_left
149	  have hbmul' : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
150	      T.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T.left, W.1)))
151	        ≤ T.left.basicOpen (r' : Γ(T.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
152	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
153	    exact inf_le_right
154	  -- glue the local pieces over the basic refinement
155	  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_glue_of_basic_compat W sub hspan
156	    (fun r : ↥sub => v (ic r.1 r.2) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r.1⟩ (hic r.1 r.2))
157	    hbmul hbmul'
158	    (fun r r' => by
159	      -- the overlap compatibility, from `res` and `glue`
160	      rw [hv.res (ic r.1 r.2) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩ ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r.1⟩
161	          ((hbmul r r').trans (hic r.1 r.2)) (hic r.1 r.2) (hbmul r r'),
162	        hv.res (ic r'.1 r'.2) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩ ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r'.1⟩
163	          ((hbmul' r r').trans (hic r'.1 r'.2)) (hic r'.1 r'.2) (hbmul' r r')]
164	      exact hv.glue (ic r.1 r.2) (ic r'.1 r'.2) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩
165	        ((hbmul r r').trans (hic r.1 r.2)) ((hbmul' r r').trans (hic r'.1 r'.2)))
166	  -- the glued value has the characterizing property
167	  refine ⟨z, fun W₀ hW₀ i hi => ?_⟩
168	  obtain ⟨sub₀, hspan₀, hsub₀⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W₀.2
169	    (fun U₀ => ∃ r ∈ sub, U₀ = T.left.basicOpen r)
170	    (fun w hw => by
171	      have hwW : w ∈ (⨆ r ∈ (↑sub : Set Γ(T.left, W.1)), T.left.basicOpen r) := by
172	        rw [iSup_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top _ _ hspan]
173	        exact hW₀ hw
174	      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hwW
175	      obtain ⟨hrsub, hwr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hr
176	      exact ⟨T.left.basicOpen r, hwr, ⟨r, hrsub, rfl⟩⟩)
177	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W₀ sub₀ hspan₀ (fun q hq => ?_)
178	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, hqle⟩ := hsub₀ q hq
179	  -- the left side restricts through the glued datum
180	  have hzr : DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T (T.left.basicOpen_le r)) z
181	      = v (ic r hr) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (hic r hr) := hz ⟨r, hr⟩
182	  have hL : DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T (T.left.basicOpen_le q))
183	      (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T hW₀) z)
184	      = v (ic r hr) ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩ (hqle.trans (hic r hr)) := by
185	    rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp,
186	      show ((T.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hW₀ : T.left.basicOpen q ≤ W.1)
187	        = (hqle.trans (T.left.basicOpen_le r)) from rfl,
188	      ← Over.resAlgHom_comp T hqle (T.left.basicOpen_le r),
189	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, hzr]
190	    exact hv.res (ic r hr) ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩ ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩
191	      (hqle.trans (hic r hr)) (hic r hr) hqle
192	  -- the right side restricts the local datum directly
193	  rw [hL, hv.res i ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩ W₀ ((T.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hi) hi
194	    (T.left.basicOpen_le q)]
195	  exact hv.glue (ic r hr) i ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩ (hqle.trans (hic r hr))
196	    ((T.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hi)
197	
198	/-! ## Assembling the glued section -/
199	
200	variable (hcov : ∀ p : T.left, ∃ i, p ∈ O i) (hv : LocalData O v)
201	
202	/-- The glued value at an affine open of `T.left`. -/
203	noncomputable def glueValue (W : T.left.affineOpens) : DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n :=
204	  (exists_isGlueValue hcov hv W).choose
205	
206	lemma glueValue_spec (W : T.left.affineOpens) :
207	    IsGlueValue O v W (glueValue hcov hv W) :=
208	  (exists_isGlueValue hcov hv W).choose_spec
209	
210	lemma glueValue_eq_of {W : T.left.affineOpens} {z : DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n}
211	    (hz : IsGlueValue O v W z) : glueValue hcov hv W = z :=
212	  glueValue_unique hcov (glueValue_spec hcov hv W) hz
213	
214	/-- **The glued section**: compatible local data on an open cover assembles to a
215	section of `divFamZar C π n T`. -/
216	noncomputable def glueSection : divFamZar C π n T :=
217	  ⟨fun W => glueValue hcov hv W, by
218	    intro U V h
219	    beta_reduce
220	    refine (glueValue_eq_of hcov hv ?_).symm
221	    intro W₀ hW₀ i hi
222	    rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp]
223	    exact glueValue_spec hcov hv V W₀ (hW₀.trans h) i hi⟩
224	
225	/-- The glued section restricts to the local datum on each cover member. -/
226	theorem glueSection_eq (i : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ O i) :
227	    (glueSection hcov hv).1 W = v i W hW := by
228	  have h := glueValue_spec hcov hv W W le_rfl i hW
229	  rwa [Over.resAlgHom_rfl, DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id] at h
230	
231	include hcov hv in
232	/-- **The gluing half of the Zariski sheaf property of the locally certified vehicle**
233	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6, Addendum 2 — the `picEt.existsUnique_glue_of_le_cover`
234	mirror): a family of local sections on an open cover of `T.left`, compatible on the
235	affine overlaps (`LocalData`), glues to a unique section of `divFamZar C π n T`
236	restricting to each. -/
237	theorem existsUnique_glue_of_le_cover :
238	    ∃! s : divFamZar C π n T, ∀ (i : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ O i),
239	      s.1 W = v i W hW := by
240	  refine ⟨glueSection hcov hv, fun i W hW => glueSection_eq hcov hv i W hW,
241	    fun s hs => ?_⟩
242	  refine ext_of_le_cover O hcov (fun U i hU => ?_)
243	  rw [hs i U hU, glueSection_eq hcov hv i U hU]
244	
245	end divFamZar
246	
247	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-

4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtMap
7	
8	/-!
9	# The unit of the étale sheafification: `relPicFunctor ⟶ picEtFunctor`
10	
11	The Layer-2 étale Picard functor `picEt` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEt`,
12	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtMap`) receives the honest relative Picard functor
13	through a natural transformation — the **unit of the étale sheafification**
14	(gap G4 of `informal/zeta-c2-rigidification-recon.md`, shared prerequisite of the
15	global (C2) comparison and of the degree/`Pic⁰` interface):
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.fromSpecAffine T U`: the spectrum of the section ring of an
18	  affine open `U` of a test object `T`, as a test object over `T` — the bridge between
19	  the affine-opens indexing of `picEt` and the test-object indexing of `relPic`.  Its
20	  coherences: restriction (`fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom`) and naturality along an
21	  arbitrary test morphism (`fromSpecAffine_naturality`).
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicToPicEt C T`: the component at `T` — a relative Picard class
23	  restricts along `fromSpecAffine T U` to every affine open, and each restriction is
24	  sent into the plus construction by `PicEtAff.unit`; the family is compatible by
25	  `PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit` and the coherences.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt`: **affine consistency** — on an
27	  affine test the component collapses through the affine comparison
28	  (`picEtAffineEquiv`) to the unit `PicEtAff.unit` of the plus construction, so the
29	  Layer-2 unit extends the affine unit.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtUnit C : relPicFunctor C ⟶ picEtFunctor C`: the natural
31	  transformation (naturality through the `∃!`-API `picEt.IsPullbackValue` of
32	  `picEtMapVal`).
33	
34	The (C2) comparison (`PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section`, recon §1.3) will upgrade
35	the affine components to isomorphisms over section-admitting tests; injectivity of the
36	affine components is the landed (C1) `PicEtAff.unit_injective`.
37	-/
38	
39	set_option autoImplicit false
40	
41	universe u
42	
43	open CategoryTheory Opposite
44	
45	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
46	
47	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra
48	
49	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
50	
51	noncomputable section
52	
53	/-! ## The affine-open test objects of a test object -/
54	
55	namespace Over
56	
57	/-- The spectrum of the section ring of an affine open `U ⊆ T.left`, as a test object
58	over `T`: the underlying morphism is `IsAffineOpen.fromSpec`, and it lies over `Spec k`
59	by the very definition of the section-ring algebra `Over.sectionsAlgebra`. -/
60	def fromSpecAffine (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
61	    overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1) ⟶ T :=
62	  Over.homMk U.2.fromSpec (by
63	    have h1 : Spec.map (T.hom.appLE ⊤ U.1
64	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge))
65	          ≫ (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of k))).fromSpec
66	        = U.2.fromSpec ≫ T.hom :=
67	      IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec T.hom (isAffineOpen_top _) U.2 _
68	    have h2 : (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of k))).fromSpec
69	        = Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv := by
70	      rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top, Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv]
71	    change U.2.fromSpec ≫ T.hom
72	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(T.left, U.1)))
73	    rw [Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections, Spec.map_comp, ← h2, h1])
74	
75	/-- **Naturality of `fromSpecAffine`** along an arbitrary morphism of test objects:
76	for affine opens `W ≤ f⁻¹ V`, the section-ring pullback `Over.appLEAlgHom` intertwines
77	the affine-open test objects — `IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec` in the over
78	category. -/
79	theorem fromSpecAffine_naturality {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
80	    (V : T.left.affineOpens) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) (e : W.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
81	    Over.overSpecMap (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 e) ≫ fromSpecAffine T V
82	      = fromSpecAffine T' W ≫ f := by
83	  ext : 1
84	  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 e).toRingHom)
85	      ≫ V.2.fromSpec = W.2.fromSpec ≫ f.left
86	  have h : CommRingCat.ofHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 e).toRingHom
87	      = f.left.appLE V.1 W.1 e := rfl
88	  rw [h]
89	  exact IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f.left V.2 W.2 e
90	
91	/-- **Restriction coherence of `fromSpecAffine`**: the affine-open test object of a
92	smaller affine open factors through that of a larger one, along `Spec` of the section
93	restriction. -/
94	theorem fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {U V : T.left.affineOpens}
95	    (h : U.1 ≤ V.1) :
96	    Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T h) ≫ fromSpecAffine T V = fromSpecAffine T U := by
97	  have he : U.1 ≤ (Over.Hom.left (𝟙 T)) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun x hx => by
98	    rw [Over.id_left]
99	    exact h hx
100	  rw [← Over.appLEAlgHom_id T V.1 U.1 he h, fromSpecAffine_naturality (𝟙 T) V U he,
101	    Category.comp_id]
102	
103	/-- On an affine test, the affine-open test object of the top affine open is the test
104	itself: composing with the `ΓSpecIso` identification of the section ring with the test
105	algebra gives the identity. -/
106	theorem overSpecMap_ΓTop_fromSpecAffine_top (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
107	    Over.overSpecMap (k := k) (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom
108	        ≫ fromSpecAffine (overSpec k A) (overSpecTopAffine A) = 𝟙 (overSpec k A) := by
109	  have key : Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom
110	      ≫ (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))).fromSpec
111	      = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) := by

/-!
# Open covers of schemes

This file provides the basic API for open covers of schemes.

## Main definition
- `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OpenCover`: The type of open covers of a scheme `X`,
  consisting of a family of open immersions into `X`,
  and for each `x : X` an open immersion (indexed by `f x`) that covers `x`.
- `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.affineCover`: `X.affineCover` is a choice of an affine cover of `X`.
- `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineOpenCover`: The type of affine open covers of a scheme `X`.
-/

@[expose] public section


noncomputable section

open TopologicalSpace CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.Limits

universe v v₁ v₂ u

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme

instance : MorphismProperty.HasPullbacks IsOpenImmersion where
  hasPullback _ _ := inferInstance

/-- An open cover of a scheme `X` is a cover where all component maps are open immersions. -/
abbrev OpenCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type _ := Cover.{v} (precoverage @IsOpenImmersion) X

variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : OpenCover X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
variable [∀ x, HasPullback (𝒰.f x ≫ f) g]

instance (i : 𝒰.I₀) : IsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i) := 𝒰.map_prop i

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The affine cover of a scheme. -/
def affineCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : OpenCover X := by
  choose U R h using X.local_affine
  let e (x) := (h x).some
  exact
  { I₀ := X
    X x := Spec (R x)
    f x := ⟨(e x).inv ≫ X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict _⟩
    mem₀ := by
      rw [presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff]
      refine ⟨fun x ↦ ⟨x, ⟨(e x).hom.base ⟨x, (U x).2⟩, ?_⟩⟩, inferInstance⟩
      change ((((e x).hom ≫ (e x).inv).base ≫ (X.ofRestrict _).base)) ⟨x, _⟩ = x
      cat_disch }

instance : Inhabited X.OpenCover :=
  ⟨X.affineCover⟩

theorem OpenCover.iSup_opensRange {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : Scheme.OpenCover.{v} X) :
    ⨆ i, (𝒰.f i).opensRange = ⊤ :=
  Opens.ext <| by rw [Opens.coe_iSup]; exact 𝒰.iUnion_range

/-- The ranges of the maps in a scheme-theoretic open cover are a topological open cover. -/
lemma OpenCover.isOpenCover_opensRange {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : OpenCover.{v} X) :
    IsOpenCover fun i ↦ (𝒰.f i).opensRange :=
  .mk 𝒰.iSup_opensRange

/-- Every open cover of a quasi-compact scheme can be refined into a finite subcover.
-/
@[simps! X f]
def OpenCover.finiteSubcover {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : OpenCover.{v} X) [H : CompactSpace X] :
    OpenCover X := by
  have :=
    @CompactSpace.elim_nhds_subcover _ _ H (fun x : X => Set.range (𝒰.f (𝒰.idx x)))
      fun x => (IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range (𝒰.f (𝒰.idx x))).mem_nhds (𝒰.covers x)
  let t := this.choose
  have h : ∀ x : X, ∃ y : t, x ∈ Set.range (𝒰.f (𝒰.idx y)) := by
    intro x
    have h' : x ∈ (⊤ : Set X) := trivial
    rw [← Classical.choose_spec this, Set.mem_iUnion] at h'
    rcases h' with ⟨y, _, ⟨hy, rfl⟩, hy'⟩
    exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hy'⟩
  exact
    { I₀ := t
      X := fun x => 𝒰.X (𝒰.idx x.1)
      f := fun x => 𝒰.f (𝒰.idx x.1)
      mem₀ := by
        rw [presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff]
        exact ⟨h, inferInstance⟩ }

instance [H : CompactSpace X] : Fintype 𝒰.finiteSubcover.I₀ := by
  delta OpenCover.finiteSubcover; infer_instance

theorem OpenCover.compactSpace {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀]
    [H : ∀ i, CompactSpace (𝒰.X i)] : CompactSpace X := by
  cases nonempty_fintype 𝒰.I₀
  rw [← isCompact_univ_iff, ← 𝒰.iUnion_range]
  apply isCompact_iUnion
  intro i
  rw [isCompact_iff_compactSpace]
  exact
    @Homeomorph.compactSpace _ _ _ _ (H i)
      (TopCat.homeoOfIso
        (asIso
          (IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq (𝒰.f i)
            (X.ofRestrict (Opens.isOpenEmbedding ⟨_, (𝒰.map_prop i).base_open.isOpen_range⟩))
            Subtype.range_coe.symm).hom.base))
/--
An affine open cover of `X` consists of a family of open immersions into `X` from
spectra of rings.
-/
abbrev AffineOpenCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type _ :=
  AffineCover.{v} @IsOpenImmersion X

namespace AffineOpenCover

instance {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.AffineOpenCover) (j : 𝒰.I₀) : IsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f j) :=
  𝒰.map_prop j

/-- The open cover associated to an affine open cover. -/
@[simps! I₀ X f]
def openCover {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.AffineOpenCover) : X.OpenCover :=
  AffineCover.cover 𝒰

end AffineOpenCover

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A choice of an affine open cover of a scheme. -/
@[simps]
def affineOpenCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : X.AffineOpenCover where
  X := _
  I₀ := X.affineCover.I₀
  f := X.affineCover.f
  idx x := (X.affineCover.exists_eq x).choose
  covers x := (X.affineCover.exists_eq x).choose_spec

@[simp]
lemma openCover_affineOpenCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : X.affineOpenCover.openCover = X.affineCover :=
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Given any open cover `𝓤`, this is an affine open cover which refines it.

/-!
# Covers of schemes

This file provides the basic API for covers of schemes. A cover of a scheme `X` with respect to
a morphism property `P` is a jointly surjective indexed family of scheme morphisms with
target `X` all satisfying `P`.

## Implementation details

The definition on the pullback of a cover along a morphism depends on results that
are developed later in the import tree. Hence in this file, they have additional assumptions
that will be automatically satisfied in later files. The motivation here is that we already
know that these assumptions are satisfied for open immersions and hence the cover API for open
immersions can be used to deduce these assumptions in the general case.

-/

@[expose] public section


noncomputable section

open TopologicalSpace CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.Limits

universe v v₁ v₂ u

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme

variable (K : Precoverage Scheme.{u})

/-- A coverage `K` on `Scheme` is called jointly surjective if every covering family in `K`
is jointly surjective. -/
class JointlySurjective (K : Precoverage Scheme.{u}) : Prop where
  exists_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} (S : Presieve X) (hS : S ∈ K X) (x : X) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X), S g ∧ x ∈ Set.range g

/-- A cover of `X` in the coverage `K` is a `0`-hypercover for `K`. -/
abbrev Cover (K : Precoverage Scheme.{u}) := Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.{v} K

variable {K}

variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.Cover K) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
variable [∀ x, HasPullback (𝒰.f x ≫ f) g]

lemma Cover.exists_eq [JointlySurjective K] (𝒰 : X.Cover K) (x : X) :
    ∃ i y, 𝒰.f i y = x := by
  obtain ⟨Y, g, ⟨i⟩, y, hy⟩ := JointlySurjective.exists_eq 𝒰.presieve₀ 𝒰.mem₀ x
  use i, y

/-- A choice of an index `i` such that `x` is in the range of `𝒰.f i`. -/
def Cover.idx [JointlySurjective K] (𝒰 : X.Cover K) (x : X) : 𝒰.I₀ :=
  (𝒰.exists_eq x).choose

lemma Cover.covers [JointlySurjective K] (𝒰 : X.Cover K) (x : X) :
    x ∈ Set.range (𝒰.f (𝒰.idx x)) :=
  (𝒰.exists_eq x).choose_spec

theorem Cover.iUnion_range [JointlySurjective K] {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.Cover K) :
    ⋃ i, Set.range (𝒰.f i) = Set.univ := by
  rw [Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
  intro x
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
  exact 𝒰.exists_eq x

instance Cover.nonempty_of_nonempty [JointlySurjective K] [Nonempty X] (𝒰 : X.Cover K) :
    Nonempty 𝒰.I₀ := by
  obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := 𝒰.exists_eq ‹Nonempty X›.some
  use i

section MorphismProperty

variable {P Q : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}}

lemma presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff (E : PreZeroHypercover X) :
    E.presieve₀ ∈ precoverage P X ↔ (∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (E.f i)) ∧ ∀ i, P (E.f i) := by
  simp

@[grind ←]
lemma Cover.map_prop (𝒰 : X.Cover (precoverage P)) (i : 𝒰.I₀) : P (𝒰.f i) :=
  𝒰.mem₀.2 ⟨i⟩

/-- Given a family of schemes with morphisms to `X` satisfying `P` that jointly
cover `X`, `Cover.mkOfCovers` is an associated `P`-cover of `X`. -/
@[simps!]
def Cover.mkOfCovers (J : Type*) (obj : J → Scheme.{u}) (map : (j : J) → obj j ⟶ X)
    (covers : ∀ x, ∃ j y, map j y = x)
    (map_prop : ∀ j, P (map j) := by infer_instance) : X.Cover (precoverage P) where
  I₀ := J
  X := obj
  f := map
  mem₀ := by
    simp_rw [presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff, Set.mem_range]
    grind

/-- An isomorphism `X ⟶ Y` is a `P`-cover of `Y`. -/
@[simps! I₀ X f]
def coverOfIsIso [P.ContainsIdentities] [P.RespectsIso] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsIso f] : Cover.{v} (precoverage P) Y :=
  .mkOfCovers PUnit (fun _ ↦ X)
    (fun _ ↦ f)
    (fun x ↦ ⟨⟨⟩, inv f x, by simp [← Hom.comp_apply]⟩)
    (fun _ ↦ P.of_isIso f)

instance : JointlySurjective (precoverage P) where
  exists_eq {X} R := fun ⟨hR, _⟩ x ↦ by
    rw [jointlySurjectivePrecoverage, Presieve.mem_comap_jointlySurjectivePrecoverage_iff] at hR
    obtain ⟨Y, g, hg, heq⟩ := hR x
    use Y, g, hg
    exact heq

/-- Turn a `K`-cover into a `Q`-cover by showing that the components satisfy `Q`. -/
def Cover.changeProp [JointlySurjective K] (𝒰 : X.Cover K) (h : ∀ j, Q (𝒰.f j)) :
    X.Cover (precoverage Q) where
  I₀ := 𝒰.I₀
  X := 𝒰.X
  f := 𝒰.f
  mem₀ := by
    rw [presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff]
    exact ⟨𝒰.exists_eq, h⟩

/-- We construct a cover from another, by providing the needed fields and showing that the
provided fields are isomorphic with the original cover. -/
@[simps I₀ X f]
def Cover.copy [P.RespectsIso] {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.Cover (precoverage P))
    (J : Type*) (obj : J → Scheme)
    (map : ∀ i, obj i ⟶ X) (e₁ : J ≃ 𝒰.I₀) (e₂ : ∀ i, obj i ≅ 𝒰.X (e₁ i))

  I₀ := J

/-- An open subset of a scheme is affine if the open subscheme is affine. -/
def IsAffineOpen {X : Scheme} (U : X.Opens) : Prop :=
  IsAffine U

/-- The set of affine opens as a subset of `opens X`. -/
def Scheme.affineOpens (X : Scheme) : Set X.Opens :=
  {U : X.Opens | IsAffineOpen U}

instance {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens) : IsAffine U :=
  U.property

theorem isAffineOpen_opensRange {X Y : Scheme} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [H : IsOpenImmersion f] : IsAffineOpen f.opensRange := by
  refine .of_isIso (IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq f (Y.ofRestrict _) ?_).inv
  exact Subtype.range_val.symm

theorem isAffineOpen_top (X : Scheme) [IsAffine X] : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : X.Opens) := by
  convert! isAffineOpen_opensRange (𝟙 X)
  ext1
  exact Set.range_id.symm

theorem exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset {X : Scheme.{u}} {x : X}
    {U : X.Opens} (hxU : x ∈ U) : ∃ W : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ W.1 ⊆ U := by
  obtain ⟨R, f, hf⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_affine_mem_range_and_range_subset hxU
  exact ⟨Scheme.Hom.opensRange f (H := hf.1),
    ⟨AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineOpen_opensRange f (H := hf.1), hf.2.1, hf.2.2⟩⟩

lemma Scheme.exists_Spec_apply_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} (x : X) :
    ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : Spec R ⟶ X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion f) (y : Spec R),
    f.base y = x :=
  ⟨X.affineOpenCover.X _, X.affineOpenCover.f _, inferInstance, X.affineOpenCover.covers x⟩

instance Scheme.isAffine_affineCover (X : Scheme) (i : X.affineCover.I₀) :
    IsAffine (X.affineCover.X i) :=
  isAffine_Spec _

instance Scheme.isAffine_affineBasisCover (X : Scheme) (i : X.affineBasisCover.I₀) :
    IsAffine (X.affineBasisCover.X i) :=
  isAffine_Spec _

instance Scheme.isAffine_affineOpenCover (X : Scheme) (𝒰 : X.AffineOpenCover) (i : 𝒰.I₀) :
    IsAffine (𝒰.openCover.X i) :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsAffine (Spec (𝒰.X i)))

instance (X : Scheme) [CompactSpace X] (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [∀ i, IsAffine (𝒰.X i)] (i) :
    IsAffine (𝒰.finiteSubcover.X i) :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsAffine (𝒰.X _))

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
instance {X} [IsAffine X] (i) :
    IsAffine ((Scheme.coverOfIsIso (P := @IsOpenImmersion) (𝟙 X)).X i) := by
  dsimp; infer_instance

theorem Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens (X : Scheme) : Opens.IsBasis X.affineOpens := by
  rw [Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
  rintro U x (hU : x ∈ (U : Set X))
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hxS, hSU⟩ := X.affineBasisCover_is_basis.exists_subset_of_mem_open hU U.isOpen
  refine ⟨⟨S, X.affineBasisCover_is_basis.isOpen hS⟩, ?_, hxS, hSU⟩
  rcases hS with ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact isAffineOpen_opensRange _

theorem iSup_affineOpens_eq_top (X : Scheme) : ⨆ i : X.affineOpens, (i : X.Opens) = ⊤ := by
  apply Opens.ext
  rw [Opens.coe_iSup]
  apply IsTopologicalBasis.sUnion_eq
  rw [← Set.image_eq_range]
  exact X.isBasis_affineOpens

theorem Scheme.map_PrimeSpectrum_basicOpen_of_affine
    (X : Scheme) [IsAffine X] (f : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    X.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen f :=
lemma isoSpec_hom_appTop :
    hU.isoSpec.hom.appTop = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).hom ≫ U.topIso.inv := by
  simp [isoSpec, Scheme.isoSpec]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
lemma isoSpec_inv_appTop :
    hU.isoSpec.inv.appTop = U.topIso.hom ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv := by
  rw [← cancel_mono hU.isoSpec.hom.appTop, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, isoSpec_hom_appTop]
  simp
  rfl

/-- The open immersion `Spec Γ(X, U) ⟶ X` for an affine `U`. -/
def fromSpec :
    Spec Γ(X, U) ⟶ X :=
  haveI : IsAffine U := hU
  hU.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.ι

instance isOpenImmersion_fromSpec :
    IsOpenImmersion hU.fromSpec := by
  delta fromSpec
  infer_instance

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma isoSpec_inv_ι : hU.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.ι = hU.fromSpec := rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma toSpecΓ_fromSpec : U.toSpecΓ ≫ hU.fromSpec = U.ι := toSpecΓ_isoSpec_inv_assoc _ _

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
@[simp]
theorem range_fromSpec :
    Set.range hU.fromSpec = U := by
  delta IsAffineOpen.fromSpec; dsimp [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv]
  rw [Set.range_comp, Set.range_eq_univ.mpr, Set.image_univ]
  · exact Subtype.range_coe
  rw [← TopCat.coe_comp, ← TopCat.epi_iff_surjective]
  infer_instance

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma fromSpec_toSpecΓ {X : Scheme} {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    hU.fromSpec ≫ X.toSpecΓ = Spec.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op) := by
  rw [fromSpec, Category.assoc, ← Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map_top,
    isoSpec_inv_toSpecΓ_assoc]

@[simp]
theorem opensRange_fromSpec : hU.fromSpec.opensRange = U := Opens.ext (range_fromSpec hU)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem map_fromSpec {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (f : op U ⟶ op V) :
    Spec.map (X.presheaf.map f) ≫ hU.fromSpec = hV.fromSpec := by
  have : IsAffine U := hU
  haveI : IsAffine _ := hV
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [fromSpec, ← X.homOfLE_ι (V := U) f.unop.le, isoSpec_inv, Category.assoc,
      ← Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality_assoc,
      ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_appTop, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [fromSpec, isoSpec_inv, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

1	/-

4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0Functor
7	
8	/-!
9	# The Jacobian representability datum (Wave-4 seam D1, `JacobianData`)
10	
11	The pinned representability datum for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative Picard
12	functor `pic0Functor C` of the challenge curve: a representing object `J`, an honest
13	`Functor.RepresentableBy` datum (no `Nonempty`, no choice), and the two construction
14	certificates (`LocallyOfFiniteType`, `QuasiCompact`).  This is the frozen Wave-4
15	interface shape (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §1.1, verbatim), together with the
16	design-§5 consumers `grpObj` / `homEquiv` / `uniqueUpToIso` — and nothing else.
17	
18	## Ownership split (binding, w5-worksheet D1)
19	
20	* The **producer** `jacobianData C : JacobianData C`, the quasi-compactness certificate,
21	  and the discharge of the frozen `Jacobian`/`instGrpObj` sorries of `Challenge.lean`
22	  are **DAT-J property** (the parallel Wave-4 fleet).  None of them lives here.
23	* This file is the **Wave-5/6/7 consumption interface**: downstream files take
24	  `(d : JacobianData C)` as a section variable, activate the group structure per proof
25	  via `letI := d.grpObj` (or `attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`), and
26	  phrase every statement about `d.J`.  At DAT-J discharge time the frozen gate
27	  instantiates them by `exact theorem_x … (jacobianData C)` — definitionally, since
28	  `Jacobian C := (jacobianData C).J`.
29	* Extensions to this file are **additive only**; the structure shape never changes.
30	
31	## The `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage
32	
33	`rep` is typed against `(pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat`
34	so that mathlib's `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies **verbatim** with
35	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat`.  The functor value at a test `T` is
36	*definitionally* the coerced subgroup `↥(pic0Subgroup C T)`; `homEquiv` and
37	`homEquiv_comp` below own this defeq once, exposing the equivalence against
38	`pic0Subgroup C T` and the naturality against `pic0Map` — no consumer ever meets the
39	`forget₂ ⋙ forget` spelling again.
40	
41	## η-defeq verdict (recon §5 "lower-order unknown", RECORDED)
42	
43	**POSITIVE, with one keying caveat.**  `Over.mk d.J.hom` is definitionally equal to
44	`d.J` (structure-eta for `Comma`/`CostructuredArrow` plus unit-like eta for the
45	`Discrete PUnit` right leg): the ascription
46	`(d.grpObj : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom))` elaborates as-is, so **no transport lemma is
47	ever needed**.  Caveat: bare instance *search* does not unfold `Over.mk` on its own,
48	so a consumer of `smooth_of_grpObj` — whose group hypothesis is `[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]`
49	at `f := d.J.hom` — must key the instance at the `Over.mk` spelling:
50	`letI : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj` (pure defeq, zero cost; mathlib itself
51	uses the same ascription idiom in `Group/Smooth.lean`).  Instances stated directly on
52	`G : Over (Spec (.of K))` (e.g. `IsClosedImmersion η[G].left`) fire on `d.J` with no
53	massage at all.  The `example`-level smoke tests at the bottom of this file are the
54	machine-checked record; the T-chain (tangent lane) and S2 (`Smooth` via
55	`smooth_of_grpObj`) may rely on this freely.
56	
57	## Main declarations
58	
59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData C` — the frozen datum structure.
60	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.grpObj` — the group-object structure on `d.J` via
61	  `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` (the discharge route of the frozen `instGrpObj`).
62	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.homEquiv` / `homEquiv_comp` — the universal property
63	  in consumer form: `(T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T`, natural against `pic0Map`.
64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.uniqueUpToIso` / `homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom` — any
65	  two data have canonically isomorphic representing objects (Wave-7's `baseChangeIso`
66	  mechanism), with the intertwining property.
67	-/

107	/-- The group-object structure on the representing object, via mathlib's
108	`GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` — this is the (definitional) discharge route of the frozen
109	`Jacobian.instGrpObj`.  Not a global instance here (the datum is a section variable);
110	activate per proof with `letI := d.grpObj` or
111	`attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`. -/
112	@[implicit_reducible]
113	noncomputable def grpObj (d : JacobianData C) : GrpObj d.J :=
114	  GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy d.J (pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) d.rep
115	
116	/-- **The universal property, consumer form**: morphisms into `d.J` are degree-zero
117	étale Picard classes.  This accessor owns the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` defeq massage once:
118	the target is the honest subgroup carrier `pic0Subgroup C T`. -/
119	def homEquiv (d : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} :
120	    (T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T :=
121	  d.rep.homEquiv
122	
123	/-- Naturality of `homEquiv` against the degree-zero restriction maps `pic0Map`
124	(element form of the `RepresentableBy` naturality, with the functor value unfolded
125	through `forget₂ ⋙ forget`). -/
126	theorem homEquiv_comp (d : JacobianData C) {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
127	    (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ d.J) :
128	    d.homEquiv (f ≫ g) = pic0Map C f (d.homEquiv g) :=
129	  d.rep.homEquiv_comp f g
130	
131	/-- Representing objects are unique up to isomorphism (mathlib
132	`Functor.RepresentableBy.uniqueUpToIso`): any two Jacobian data for the same curve have
133	canonically isomorphic `J`.  This is Wave-7's `baseChangeIso` mechanism. -/
134	noncomputable def uniqueUpToIso (d d' : JacobianData C) : d.J ≅ d'.J :=
135	  d.rep.uniqueUpToIso d'.rep

137	/-- The intertwining property of `uniqueUpToIso`: composing with the canonical
138	isomorphism commutes with the two universal properties. -/
139	theorem homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom (d d' : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
140	    (f : T ⟶ d.J) :
141	    d'.homEquiv (f ≫ (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom) = d.homEquiv f := by
142	  have h : (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom = d'.rep.homEquiv.symm (d.rep.homEquiv (𝟙 d.J)) := rfl
143	  rw [homEquiv, homEquiv, h, Functor.RepresentableBy.comp_homEquiv_symm]
144	  exact (d'.rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).trans (d.rep.homEquiv_eq f).symm

17	
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0TypeFunctor C`: the degree-zero Picard functor with values in
19	  types — the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage of `pic0Functor`, owned here once
20	  (`pic0TypeFunctor_obj`/`pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply` are `rfl`).
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0SigmaFunctor C : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u`: the Σ-extension
22	  `T ↦ Σ (a : T ⟶ Spec k), pic⁰(Over.mk a)` — the big-site carrier.
23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf` / **`pic0SigmaSheaf C`**: the sheaf
24	  certificate.  By mathlib's own reduction the big-site sheaf condition collapses to
25	  elementwise ∃!-amalgamation on honest open covers
26	  (`Precoverage.isSheaf_toGrothendieck_iff_of_isStableUnderBaseChange`,
27	  `exists_cover_of_mem_pretopology`, `Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff` — the
28	  `BigZariski` TODO is never touched): the Σ-components glue by
29	  `Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms`, the fibre components glue by the DAT-6 stage-1
30	  evaluation bridge (`pic0Subgroup_existsUnique_of_cover`), and the two layers are
31	  stitched by the stage-2 amalgamation seam (`sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff`) and
32	  compatibility descent (`map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq`).
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`: **the DAT-glue seam** — given a
34	  chart family of relatively representable open immersions into `pic0SigmaSheaf`
35	  (DAT-C) that is jointly locally surjective (DAT-B), mathlib's
36	  `Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy` produces a representation of the
37	  Σ-extension by the glued scheme, and the stage-2 Σ-descent `overSlice` turns it
38	  into a representation of `pic0TypeFunctor C` by the glued scheme over the
39	  Σ-component of the universal element.
40	-/

46	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

50	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
51	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
52	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

54	/-! ## The type-valued degree-zero Picard functor -/
55	
56	/-- The degree-zero Picard functor with values in types: the `forget₂ ⋙ forget`
57	massage of `pic0Functor`, owned here once for the Σ-extension statements. -/
58	noncomputable abbrev pic0TypeFunctor : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
59	  (pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat
60	
61	@[simp]
62	lemma pic0TypeFunctor_obj (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
63	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).obj T = pic0Subgroup C T.unop :=
64	  rfl
65	
66	lemma pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ} (g : T ⟶ T')
67	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C T.unop) :
68	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g lam = pic0Map C g.unop lam :=
69	  rfl

71	/-! ## The Σ-extension as a presheaf on the big site -/
72	
73	/-- **The big-site carrier of the slice trick**: the Σ-extension of the type-valued
74	degree-zero Picard functor, `T ↦ Σ (a : T ⟶ Spec k), pic⁰(Over.mk a)`.  Reducible so
75	that the stage-2 `sigmaExtension` calculus applies syntactically. -/
76	noncomputable abbrev pic0SigmaFunctor : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
77	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (pic0TypeFunctor C)
78	
79	variable [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
80	
81	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
82	-- The amalgamation seams unify the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage of `pic0Functor`
83	-- against the Σ-extension calculus by unfolding; within the DAT-2/PicEtMap 1600000
84	-- precedent.
85	/-- **The big-site Zariski sheaf certificate of the Σ-extension** (DAT-6 keystone,
86	worksheet §1.2 site gap 1): mathlib's reduction collapses the sheaf condition to
87	elementwise ∃!-amalgamation on honest open covers, where the Σ-components glue by
88	`Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms` and the fibre components by the stage-1 evaluation
89	bridge. -/
90	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf :
91	    Presieve.IsSheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology (pic0SigmaFunctor C) := by
92	  rw [Precoverage.isSheaf_toGrothendieck_iff_of_isStableUnderBaseChange]
93	  intro Y S hS
94	  obtain ⟨𝓤, rfl⟩ := Scheme.exists_cover_of_mem_pretopology hS
95	  rw [Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff]
96	  intro x hx
97	  -- glue the Σ-components along the scheme-level cover
98	  have hpair : ∀ i j, pullback.fst (𝓤.f i) (𝓤.f j) ≫ (x i).1
99	      = pullback.snd (𝓤.f i) (𝓤.f j) ≫ (x j).1 := fun i j =>
100	    congrArg Sigma.fst
101	      (hx i j (pullback (𝓤.f i) (𝓤.f j)) (pullback.fst _ _) (pullback.snd _ _)
102	        pullback.condition)
103	  obtain ⟨aY, ha⟩ : ∃ aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k), ∀ i, 𝓤.f i ≫ aY = (x i).1 :=
104	    ⟨𝓤.glueMorphisms (fun i => (x i).1) hpair,
105	      fun i => 𝓤.ι_glueMorphisms (fun i => (x i).1) hpair i⟩
106	  -- the induced slice cover of `Over.mk aY` and its member sections
107	  haveI hop : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion
108	      ((Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)).left :=
109	    fun i => 𝓤.map_prop i
110	  have hcov : ∀ p : (Over.mk aY).left, ∃ i, p ∈ Scheme.Hom.opensRange
111	      ((Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)).left := by
112	    intro p
113	    obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := 𝓤.exists_eq p
114	    exact ⟨i, y, hy⟩
115	  -- the fibre components are a compatible family on the slice cover
116	  have hcompat : ∀ (i j : 𝓤.I₀) (Z : Over (Spec (.of k)))
117	      (gi : Z ⟶ Over.mk ((x i).1)) (gj : Z ⟶ Over.mk ((x j).1)),
118	      gi ≫ (Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)
119	          = gj ≫ (Over.homMk (𝓤.f j) (ha j) : Over.mk ((x j).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY) →
120	      pic0Map C gi ((x i).2) = pic0Map C gj ((x j).2) := by
121	    intro i j Z gi gj hg
122	    have hleft : gi.left ≫ 𝓤.f i = gj.left ≫ 𝓤.f j := congrArg Over.Hom.left hg
123	    have hdesc := Over.map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq gi gj
124	      (hx i j Z.left gi.left gj.left hleft)
125	    rwa [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply, pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply] at hdesc
126	  -- glue the fibre components by the stage-1 evaluation bridge
127	  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsu⟩ := pic0Subgroup_existsUnique_of_cover
128	    (fun i => (Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY))
129	    hcov (fun i => (x i).2) hcompat
130	  refine ⟨⟨aY, s⟩, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
131	  · -- the glued Σ-element restricts to the members
132	    refine (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (𝓤.f i) (ha i) s ((x i).2)).mpr ?_
133	    rw [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply]
134	    exact hs i
135	  · -- uniqueness: Σ-components by `hom_ext`, fibres by bridge separation
136	    rintro ⟨a', s'⟩ ht'
137	    obtain rfl : aY = a' := 𝓤.hom_ext aY a' fun i =>
138	      (ha i).trans (congrArg Sigma.fst (ht' i) : 𝓤.f i ≫ a' = (x i).1).symm
139	    refine congrArg (Sigma.mk aY) (hsu s' fun i => ?_)
140	    have hmem := (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (𝓤.f i) (ha i) s' ((x i).2)).mp
141	      (ht' i)
142	    rwa [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply] at hmem
143	
144	/-- **The Σ-extension of the degree-zero Picard functor, bundled as a sheaf on the
145	big Zariski site** — the object mathlib's 01JJ local-representability engine
146	consumes. -/
147	noncomputable def pic0SigmaSheaf : Sheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology.{u} (Type u) :=
148	  ⟨pic0SigmaFunctor C,
149	    (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf C)⟩
150	
151	/-! ## The DAT-glue seam -/
152	
153	/-- **The DAT-glue statement (worksheet §4, DAT-glue row)**: a chart family of
154	relatively representable open immersions into the Σ-extension sheaf (DAT-C's
155	certificates) that is jointly Zariski-locally surjective (DAT-B's coverage) induces —
156	through mathlib's 01JJ engine and the stage-2 Σ-descent — a representation of the
157	type-valued degree-zero Picard functor by the glued scheme placed over the
158	Σ-component of the universal element.  The represented object's `.left` is
159	`(Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued` and its `.hom` is the universal
160	element's Σ-component, both definitionally. -/
161	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableByOfCharts
162	    {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
163	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
164	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
165	    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f)] :
166	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
167	      (Over.mk ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv
168	        (𝟙 (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued)).1) :=
169	  (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).overSlice
